verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer that runs on Stripe. Its `attach` endpoint handles new subscriptions and creates a Stripe subscription, so a founder can charge customers once Stripe is connected and plans are defined, either via the `atmn` CLI or the dashboard. However, the evidence never describes a card checkout or payment page, and it relies on a separate Stripe account rather than Autumn processing cards itself. Missing for 10: explicit checkout/card-collection flow documentation, evidence of time-to-first-payment or quick onboarding, native payment processing without a separate Stripe setup, and independent hands-on corroboration.
